scenes.heading: How long will this take to read?
scenes.sub: Reading time and difficulty for any text.
scenes.say: Readable tells you how long any text takes to read, and how hard it is.

type: Short sentences are easy to read. Long ones, full of clauses, are not.

scenes.say: Paste some text and press measure. You get the reading time, the word count and a difficulty score.

scenes.caption: the formula
scenes.say: The score is the Flesch reading ease formula: shorter sentences and shorter words score higher.
And the tests run, for real.

scenes.heading: Readable
scenes.say: That is Readable. Try it on your own writing.
